licence.title: Plan & licence
licence.description: Only changed fields are sent and written to the centre's activity ledger with old/new values.

suspendDialog.detailGrace: {count} students keep their plan for a 7-day grace period (until {date}), then it is cut automatically.
suspendDialog.detailLedger: The action is written to the centre's activity ledger under your name (admin) — the director can read it.

reactivateDialog.title: Reactivate {org}?
reactivateDialog.description: The centre is active again immediately, without waiting for the background job.
reactivateDialog.detailClearAnchor: Clears the suspension anchor — a later suspension gets the full 7-day grace period again.

void.title: Void invoice #{id}?
void.detailFinal: The invoice is voided permanently and cannot be reopened; its transfer code no longer matches incoming payments.
